claim: ImageHandler.readImage fetches metadata with getDataWithMetadata, but RAW_VIEW never uses it. The mime type is already set from the image content whenever the image is non-null, and the length is reset to null right after, so plain getData would save one readAttributes per image read on local storage.
evidence: Mutation probe (reverted with git checkout): I replaced loaded.metadata() in ImageHandler.getObs with ObjectMetadata(mime 'bogus/x', length 999). ImageHandlerTest stayed 9/9 green, including the mime-type assertions at ImageHandlerTest.java:100,102,129. Code: injectMissingMetadata only sets the mime type when it is null (AbstractHandler.java:177), and ImageHandler.java:94 does complexData.setLength(null). This waste predates the PR (master called getMetadata), so it is optional. Changing it would also mean updating ImageHandlerTest.getObs_shouldReadDataAndMetadataInASingleStorageCall.
